examples.en: A puff of wind blew the papers off my desk.
examples.zh: 一陣風把我桌上的紙吹落了。

examples.en: There was a small puff of smoke from the chimney.
examples.zh: 煙囪冒出一小團煙。

examples.en: She took a puff from her inhaler before the race.
examples.zh: 她在比賽前用吸入器吸了一口藥。

examples.en: Smoke puffed out of the old train's chimney.
examples.zh: 老火車的煙囪冒出陣陣煙霧。

examples.en: He was puffing after climbing the stairs to the fifth floor.
examples.zh: 他爬上五樓後氣喘吁吁。

examples.en: Her cheeks puffed out when she tried to hold her breath.
examples.zh: 她憋氣時雙頰鼓了起來。

examples.en: This machine can purify the water from the river.
examples.zh: 這台機器可以淨化河水。

examples.en: Plants help purify the air inside our homes.
examples.zh: 植物有助於淨化我們家中的空氣。

examples.en: Many people use filters to purify tap water before drinking it.
examples.zh: 許多人在飲用自來水前會用濾水器來淨化。

examples.en: The purity of the mountain water impressed all the visitors.
examples.zh: 山泉水的純淨讓所有遊客印象深刻。

examples.en: Gold jewelry is tested for purity before it goes on sale.
examples.zh: 金飾在上市前會先檢驗純度。

examples.en: The label says the salt has a purity of 99 percent.
examples.zh: 標籤上寫著這種鹽的純度為百分之九十九。

examples.en: A strong quake shook the city early in the morning.
examples.zh: 一場強震在清晨搖晃了整座城市。

examples.en: Many buildings were damaged in the quake last year.
examples.zh: 去年的地震使許多建築物受損。

examples.en: Schools hold drills so students know what to do in a quake.
examples.zh: 學校舉行演習，讓學生知道地震時該怎麼做。

examples.en: The old bridge quaked when the heavy truck drove across it.
examples.zh: 重型卡車駛過時，老橋隨之晃動。

examples.en: The whole building quaked as the train passed underneath.
examples.zh: 火車從下方經過時，整棟大樓都在搖晃。

examples.en: Her voice quaked with fear as she answered the phone.
examples.zh: 她接電話時聲音因害怕而顫抖。

senses.zh: 容光煥發的；燦爛的；明亮的

examples.en: The bride looked radiant in her white dress.
examples.zh: 新娘穿著白紗，看起來容光煥發。

examples.en: A radiant smile spread across her face when she saw the gift.
examples.zh: 她看到禮物時，臉上綻放燦爛的笑容。

examples.en: The radiant sun lit up the whole valley.
examples.zh: 明亮的太陽照亮了整座山谷。

examples.en: The heater radiates heat to every corner of the room.
examples.zh: 暖氣機把熱量散發到房間的每個角落。

examples.en: She radiates confidence whenever she walks on stage.
examples.zh: 她每次走上舞台都散發著自信。

examples.en: Several roads radiate from the town square.
examples.zh: 幾條道路從市鎮廣場向四周延伸。

examples.en: Scientists study how radioactive materials change over time.
examples.zh: 科學家研究放射性物質如何隨時間變化。

examples.en: The hospital stores radioactive substances in special containers.
examples.zh: 醫院把放射性物質存放在特殊的容器裡。

examples.en: Radioactive waste must be handled with great care.
examples.zh: 放射性廢棄物必須非常小心處理。

examples.en: My grandmother added a sliced radish to the salad.
examples.zh: 我祖母在沙拉裡加了切片的小蘿蔔。

examples.en: The farmer pulled a big radish out of the soil.
examples.zh: 農夫從土裡拔出一根大蘿蔔。

examples.en: Radish soup is a popular dish during the winter.
examples.zh: 蘿蔔湯是冬天很受歡迎的一道菜。

examples.en: The radius of this circle is five centimeters.
examples.zh: 這個圓的半徑是五公分。

examples.en: There are three convenience stores within a one-kilometer radius.
examples.zh: 一公里範圍內有三家便利商店。

examples.en: The radius of the Earth is about 6,400 kilometers.
examples.zh: 地球的半徑約為六千四百公里。

senses.zh: 饒舌音樂；饒舌歌；輕敲聲

examples.en: My brother loves rap and listens to it on the bus.
examples.zh: 我哥哥喜歡饒舌，搭公車時也在聽。

examples.en: She wrote a rap about her school for the talent show.
examples.zh: 她為才藝表演寫了一首關於學校的饒舌歌。

examples.en: A sharp rap on the classroom door interrupted the lesson.
examples.zh: 教室門上傳來一聲急促的敲門聲，打斷了課程。

examples.en: Someone rapped on the door while I was cooking.
examples.zh: 我煮飯時有人敲了門。

examples.en: The teacher rapped the desk to get the class's attention.
examples.zh: 老師敲了敲桌子，吸引全班的注意。

examples.en: He learned to rap by practicing the rhythm of his favorite songs.
examples.zh: 他藉由練習最喜愛歌曲的節奏，學習饒舌演唱。

examples.en: The baby has a red rash on her arm.
examples.zh: 這個嬰兒的手臂上有紅疹。

examples.en: A rash appeared on his neck after he ate the shrimp.
examples.zh: 他吃了蝦子後，脖子上起了疹子。

examples.en: The doctor gave me some cream for the rash.
examples.zh: 醫生給了我一些治療皮疹的藥膏。

examples.en: It was a rash decision to quit without another job.
examples.zh: 沒有另一份工作就辭職是個輕率的決定。

examples.en: Don't make a rash promise you cannot keep.
examples.zh: 不要做出你無法兌現的輕率承諾。

examples.en: He regretted his rash words after the meeting.
examples.zh: 他在會議後後悔自己那些魯莽的話。

examples.en: The council will ratify the new agreement next week.
examples.zh: 委員會下週將批准這項新協議。

examples.en: Both countries must ratify the treaty before it takes effect.
examples.zh: 兩國在條約生效前都必須批准該條約。

examples.en: Members voted to ratify the changes to the club rules.
examples.zh: 會員投票通過了對社團規章的修改。

examples.en: She came to the realization that she needed more sleep.
examples.zh: 她領悟到自己需要更多睡眠。

examples.en: The realization of his dream took ten years of hard work.
examples.zh: 他花了十年努力才實現夢想。

examples.en: There is a growing realization that we must protect the environment.
examples.zh: 人們愈來愈體認到我們必須保護環境。

examples.en: Farmers reap the rice in the fall.
examples.zh: 農夫在秋天收割稻米。

examples.en: Students who study regularly will reap the benefits at exam time.
examples.zh: 規律讀書的學生在考試時會獲得成果。

examples.en: We reaped a good harvest of apples this year.
examples.zh: 今年我們的蘋果大豐收。

examples.en: Reckless driving causes many accidents on the highway.
examples.zh: 魯莽駕駛在高速公路上造成許多事故。

examples.en: It was reckless of him to swim in the river alone.
examples.zh: 他獨自在河裡游泳真是魯莽。

examples.en: The manager warned the team against reckless spending.
examples.zh: 經理警告團隊不要不顧後果地亂花錢。

examples.en: I reckon it will rain before we get to the park.
examples.zh: 我想我們到公園前就會下雨了。

examples.en: They reckon the trip will take about three hours.
examples.zh: 他們估計這趟旅程大約要三小時。

examples.en: What do you reckon we should buy for her birthday?
examples.zh: 你覺得我們該買什麼當她的生日禮物？

examples.en: The two sisters finally reconciled after a long argument.
examples.zh: 這對姊妹在長時間爭吵後終於和好了。

examples.en: It is hard to reconcile work with a busy family life.
examples.zh: 要讓工作與忙碌的家庭生活取得平衡很難。

examples.en: The accountant must reconcile the bank statement with the company's records.
examples.zh: 會計必須核對銀行對帳單與公司帳冊。

examples.en: The park offers many recreational activities for families.
examples.zh: 這座公園為家庭提供許多休閒活動。

examples.en: The school built a new recreational center for students.
examples.zh: 學校為學生蓋了一座新的娛樂中心。

examples.en: Swimming is a popular recreational sport in summer.
examples.zh: 游泳是夏天很受歡迎的休閒運動。

examples.en: The report contains a lot of redundancy and should be shorter.
examples.zh: 這份報告有很多冗餘內容，應該再精簡。

examples.en: Many workers lost their jobs because of redundancy at the factory.
examples.zh: 工廠裁員使許多員工失去工作。

examples.en: Backup systems add redundancy to keep the network running.
examples.zh: 備援系統增加冗餘，確保網路持續運作。

examples.en: Divers came to see the colorful fish around the reef.
examples.zh: 潛水客來看珊瑚礁周圍色彩繽紛的魚。

examples.en: The boat hit a reef and began to take in water.
examples.zh: 船撞上礁石，開始進水。

examples.en: Pollution is damaging the reef near the island.
examples.zh: 污染正在破壞島嶼附近的珊瑚礁。

examples.en: The referee blew the whistle to start the game.
examples.zh: 裁判吹哨宣布比賽開始。

examples.en: A referee must treat both teams fairly.
examples.zh: 裁判必須公平對待兩隊。

examples.en: She listed her former manager as a referee on her job application.
examples.zh: 她在求職申請中把前主管列為推薦人。

examples.en: The country will hold a referendum on the new law next month.
examples.zh: 該國下個月將就新法舉行公民投票。

examples.en: Voters rejected the plan in a referendum.
examples.zh: 選民在公民投票中否決了這項計畫。

examples.en: A referendum was held to decide whether to build the new stadium.
examples.zh: 為了決定是否興建新體育場，舉行了公民投票。

examples.en: The factory refines raw sugar before shipping it to stores.
examples.zh: 這間工廠先精煉粗糖，再把糖運送到商店。

examples.en: She spent the weekend refining her speech.
examples.zh: 她花了整個週末潤飾她的演講稿。

examples.en: Engineers continue to refine the design of the engine.
examples.zh: 工程師持續改良引擎的設計。

examples.en: Cyclists should wear reflective vests at night.
examples.zh: 騎自行車的人晚上應該穿反光背心。

examples.en: He was in a reflective mood after the graduation ceremony.
examples.zh: 畢業典禮後，他若有所思。

examples.en: Writing a journal is a reflective habit that helps me learn.
examples.zh: 寫日記是一種幫助我學習的反思習慣。

examples.en: Refreshments will be served after the meeting.
examples.zh: 會議結束後將供應茶點。

examples.en: The cool shower brought welcome refreshment after a long hike.
examples.zh: 長途健行後，沖個涼令人恢復精神，十分舒暢。

examples.en: The school provided light refreshments for the visiting parents.
examples.zh: 學校為來訪的家長準備了簡單的點心。

examples.en: The scientist used new data to refute the claim.
examples.zh: 科學家用新的數據駁斥那項說法。

examples.en: She quickly refuted every point in his argument.
examples.zh: 她迅速反駁了他論點中的每一項。

examples.en: The company refuted the rumor that it would close the store.
examples.zh: 公司駁斥了將關閉該店的傳聞。

examples.en: The clinic helps patients rehabilitate after serious knee injuries.
examples.zh: 這間診所協助病患在嚴重膝傷後復健。

examples.en: The city plans to rehabilitate the old train station.
examples.zh: 市政府計畫修復這座舊火車站。

examples.en: Volunteers rehabilitate injured wild birds before releasing them.
examples.zh: 志工讓受傷的野鳥恢復健康後再放生。

examples.en: The castle was built during the reign of King Henry.
examples.zh: 這座城堡是在亨利國王在位期間建造的。

examples.en: Her reign lasted for more than sixty years.
examples.zh: 她的統治持續了六十多年。

examples.en: Peace and trade grew during his long reign.
examples.zh: 在他漫長的統治期間，和平與貿易逐漸發展。

examples.en: The king reigned over a peaceful country for forty years.
examples.zh: 國王統治一個和平的國家長達四十年。

examples.en: Silence reigned in the library during exam week.
examples.zh: 考試週期間，圖書館裡一片寂靜。

examples.en: Our team has reigned as the school champion for three years.
examples.zh: 我們的隊伍已連續三年稱霸全校。

examples.en: The whole town rejoiced when the team won the final.
examples.zh: 球隊贏得決賽時，全鎮歡欣鼓舞。

examples.en: We rejoice in the good news about her recovery.
examples.zh: 我們為她康復的好消息感到欣喜。

examples.en: Children rejoiced at the first snow of the year.
examples.zh: 孩子們為今年的第一場雪歡欣雀躍。

examples.en: Our class won the relay on sports day.
examples.zh: 我們班在運動會的接力賽中獲勝。

examples.en: The relay switches the motor on when the sensor detects movement.
examples.zh: 感測器偵測到移動時，繼電器會啟動馬達。

examples.en: A signal relay on the mountain improved the phone coverage.
examples.zh: 山上的訊號中繼站改善了手機收訊。

examples.en: Please relay my thanks to your parents.
examples.zh: 請代我向你的父母轉達謝意。

examples.en: The station will relay the concert live to millions of viewers.
examples.zh: 電視台將向數百萬觀眾現場轉播這場演唱會。

examples.en: Satellites relay phone calls across the ocean.
examples.zh: 衛星跨越海洋傳送電話通話。

examples.en: The team faced relentless pressure from the crowd.
examples.zh: 球隊面對來自觀眾不間斷的壓力。

examples.en: Her relentless effort finally earned her a scholarship.
examples.zh: 她堅持不懈的努力終於為她贏得獎學金。

examples.en: The relentless heat made it hard to work outdoors.
examples.zh: 毫不間斷的酷熱讓人很難在戶外工作。

examples.en: Our reliance on cell phones keeps growing every year.
examples.zh: 我們對手機的依賴逐年增加。

examples.en: The island's reliance on tourism is a concern for the government.
examples.zh: 這座島對觀光業的依賴令政府擔憂。

examples.en: Teachers hope to reduce students' reliance on dictionaries.
examples.zh: 老師希望減少學生對字典的依賴。

examples.en: The museum displays relics from an ancient temple.
examples.zh: 博物館展出一座古代廟宇的遺物。

examples.en: This old watch is a relic of my grandfather's time.
examples.zh: 這支舊手錶是我祖父那個年代的遺物。

examples.en: Some people think paper maps are a relic of the past.
examples.zh: 有些人認為紙本地圖是過時的東西。

examples.en: I will finish the remainder of the homework tonight.
examples.zh: 我今晚會把剩下的功課寫完。

examples.en: Divide twelve by five and the remainder is two.
examples.zh: 十二除以五，餘數是二。

examples.en: The remainder of the money will go to the school library.
examples.zh: 剩下的錢將交給學校圖書館。

examples.en: The smell of the soup is reminiscent of my grandmother's kitchen.
examples.zh: 這湯的香味讓人想起祖母的廚房。

examples.en: Her style of painting is reminiscent of Monet.
examples.zh: 她的畫風讓人聯想到莫內。

examples.en: The old town has a charm reminiscent of a fairy tale.
examples.zh: 這座老城的魅力讓人聯想到童話故事。

examples.en: The city is renowned for its beautiful night markets.
examples.zh: 這座城市以美麗的夜市聞名。

examples.en: She is a renowned scientist who studies ocean life.
examples.zh: 她是一位研究海洋生物的知名科學家。

examples.en: The renowned chef opened a new restaurant downtown.
examples.zh: 這位名廚在市中心開了一家新餐廳。

examples.en: Frogs reproduce by laying eggs in the water.
examples.zh: 青蛙在水中產卵來繁殖。

examples.en: It is illegal to reproduce this book without permission.
examples.zh: 未經許可複製這本書是違法的。

examples.en: The scientists could not reproduce the results of the experiment.
examples.zh: 科學家無法重現這項實驗的結果。

examples.en: A snake is a reptile that has no legs.
examples.zh: 蛇是一種沒有腳的爬蟲類。

examples.en: The zoo has a special house for reptiles.
examples.zh: 動物園有一間專門的爬蟲館。

examples.en: Most reptiles lay eggs and need warmth from the sun.
examples.zh: 大多數爬蟲類會產卵，並需要太陽的溫暖。

examples.en: She resented her brother for getting all the attention.
examples.zh: 她怨恨哥哥獨占所有關注。

examples.en: He resented having to clean the house alone.
examples.zh: 他對必須獨自打掃房子感到不滿。

examples.en: Many employees resent the new rules about working hours.
examples.zh: 許多員工對新的工時規定感到憤慨。

examples.en: My aunt resides in Tainan with her family.
examples.zh: 我阿姨和家人住在台南。

examples.en: Students who reside outside the city can apply for a dormitory.
examples.zh: 住在市區以外的學生可以申請宿舍。

examples.en: Foreign researchers who reside in Taiwan often attend local academic conferences.
examples.zh: 居住在臺灣的外籍研究人員經常參加當地的學術研討會。

examples.en: The two students returned to their respective classrooms.
examples.zh: 兩位學生回到各自的教室。

examples.en: Parents and teachers have their respective roles in a child's education.
examples.zh: 家長和老師在孩子的教育中各有其角色。

examples.en: Please write your answers in the respective boxes.
examples.zh: 請把答案寫在各自對應的方框內。

examples.en: She tried to restrain her anger during the meeting.
examples.zh: 她試著在會議中壓抑怒氣。

examples.en: Please restrain your dog while the guests arrive.
examples.zh: 賓客抵達時，請管好你的狗。

examples.en: He could not restrain a laugh when he saw the cat's face.
examples.zh: 他看到貓的表情時忍不住笑了出來。

examples.en: The player showed great restraint and did not shout at the referee.
examples.zh: 球員表現出極大的克制，沒有對裁判大吼。

examples.en: The company asked staff to show restraint when spending on trips.
examples.zh: 公司要求員工出差時節制花費。

examples.en: A seat belt is a restraint that protects drivers in a crash.
examples.zh: 安全帶是一種在車禍時保護駕駛的約束裝置。

examples.en: "I did not break it!" he retorted.
examples.zh: 「我沒有弄壞它！」他反駁道。

examples.en: When I said the movie was boring, she retorted that I never liked anything.
examples.zh: 我說電影很無聊時，她回嘴說我從來沒喜歡過任何東西。

examples.en: Nobody dared to retort when the manager made his decision.
examples.zh: 經理做出決定時，沒有人敢回嘴。

examples.en: He climbed over the fence to retrieve the ball.
examples.zh: 他爬過圍欄去撿回球。

examples.en: You can retrieve your files from the cloud at any time.
examples.zh: 你可以隨時從雲端取回檔案。

examples.en: Trained dogs can retrieve birds that fall into the water.
examples.zh: 受過訓練的狗能把掉進水裡的鳥叼回來。

senses.zh: 揭露；令人大開眼界的事

examples.en: The revelation of the secret surprised the whole family.
examples.zh: 秘密被揭露讓全家人都很驚訝。

examples.en: Her speech was a revelation to many of us.
examples.zh: 她的演講對我們許多人是一大啟發。

examples.en: Visiting the farm was a revelation for the city kids.
examples.zh: 參觀農場對城市孩子來說是令人大開眼界的事。

examples.en: The city is enjoying a revival of interest in traditional crafts.
examples.zh: 這座城市對傳統工藝的興趣正在復甦。

examples.en: The economy showed a slow revival after the crisis.
examples.zh: 經濟在危機後緩慢復甦。

examples.en: The theater announced a revival of the famous musical.
examples.zh: 劇院宣布重演這齣著名的音樂劇。

senses.zh: 使甦醒；重振；使恢復精神

examples.en: The nurse tried to revive the man who had fainted.
examples.zh: 護理師試著讓昏倒的男子甦醒。

examples.en: The new mayor wants to revive the old market.
examples.zh: 新市長想重振這座舊市場。

examples.en: A cup of coffee helped revive me after the long trip.
examples.zh: 一杯咖啡幫我在漫長的旅程後恢復精神。

examples.en: The students organized a revolt against the unfair school rule.
examples.zh: 學生發起反抗那條不公平校規的行動。

examples.en: Peasants rose in revolt against the heavy taxes.
examples.zh: 農民起身反抗沉重的稅賦。

examples.en: The revolt spread quickly across the country.
examples.zh: 叛亂迅速蔓延全國。

examples.en: The workers revolted against the long working hours.
examples.zh: 工人起而反抗過長的工時。

examples.en: The young soldiers revolted against their commander.
examples.zh: 年輕的士兵起而反抗他們的指揮官。

examples.en: The smell of the rotten fish revolted everyone in the kitchen.
examples.zh: 腐爛魚的氣味讓廚房裡的每個人都感到厭惡。

examples.en: The Earth revolves around the sun once a year.
examples.zh: 地球每年繞著太陽公轉一圈。

examples.en: The wheel revolved slowly in the wind.
examples.zh: 輪子在風中緩緩轉動。

examples.en: Her life revolves around her family and her work.
examples.zh: 她的生活圍繞著家人和工作。
